```yaml
name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --distpath dist --name a2a-scanner a2a_scanner.py
          # If the entry point is different, adjust the command accordingly

      - name: Create tar.gz archive
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-${TAG}-arm64.tar.gz -C dist a2a-scanner

      - name: Upload asset to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Compute SHA256 of archive
        id: sha
        run: |
          SHA=$(shasum -a 256 a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "sha=$SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          SHA=${{ steps.sha.outputs.sha }}

          # Clone the tap repository
          git clone https://x-access-token:${HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git
          cd homebrew-ai-defense

          # Update the formula
          FORMULA=Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          if [ -f "$FORMULA" ]; then
            # Update version and sha256
            sed -i '' "s/^  version .*/  version \"${TAG}\"/" "$FORMULA"
            sed -i '' "s/^  sha256 .*/  sha256 \"${SHA}\"/" "$FORMULA"
          else
            echo "Formula file $FORMULA not found."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Commit and push changes
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add "$FORMULA"
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to ${TAG}"
          git push origin main
```
